title: Structured Evidence Routing for Incident Risk Prediction from Multimodal Longitudinal EHRs
abstract: arXiv:2608.26191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Incident risk prediction from longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) is challenging because relevant signals are multimodal, weak in isolation, and distributed across irregular patient histories. We propose structured evidence routing, a router-predictor-reviewer workflow that separates full-record access from disease-specific assessment. The router organizes the complete pre-index EHR into a compact summary and targeted evidence slices; the predictor uses this evidence to form an evidence-linked risk assessment, which the reviewer critiques. For comparison with supervised EHRSHOT baselines, we pair the routed evidence summaries with a supervised classifier readout. Across five 1-year incident diagnosis tasks, our method reaches the AUROC range of established supervised EHRSHOT baselines and remains competitive on AUPRC, while exposing a patient-specific evidence trail. translated_title: 结构化证据路由用于多模态纵向电子健康记录中的事件风险预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26191v1 公告类型：新  摘要：从纵向电子健康记录（EHRs）中进行事件风险预测具有挑战性，因为相关信号是多模态的、孤立时微弱，并且分布在不规则的患者病史中。我们提出了结构化证据路由，一种路由器-预测器-审查器工作流程，将完整记录访问与疾病特定评估分离。路由器将索引前的完整EHR组织成紧凑摘要和有针对性的证据片段；预测器利用这些证据形成与证据关联的风险评估，并由审查器进行批判。为了与监督式EHRSHOT基线进行比较，我们将路由后的证据摘要与监督式分类器读出配对。在五项1年事件诊断任务中，我们的方法达到了既定监督式EHRSHOT基线的AUROC范围，并在AUPRC上保持竞争力，同时暴露了患者特定的证据轨迹。内部预读出消融进一步表明，路由有助于提升性能。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结构化证据路由方法，通过路由器-预测器-审查器流程有效整合多模态纵向EHR数据，在保持与监督基线相当性能的同时提供可解释的患者特定证据轨迹。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a structured evidence routing method with a router-predictor-reviewer workflow to effectively integrate multimodal longitudinal EHR data, achieving competitive performance with supervised baselines while providing interpretable patient-specific evidence trails.
